# Telemetry reference

The attributes, metrics, spans and events this add-on defines in its
[Weaver](https://github.com/open-telemetry/weaver) registry ([`model/`](../model/)), on top of
the [OpenTelemetry semantic conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/).

## Attributes

### Home Assistant run attributes

An automation or script run read from Home Assistant's trace store.

| Attribute | Type | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `homeassistant.alias` | string | Human name of the automation or script. | `Piscina` |
| `homeassistant.context.id` | string | Home Assistant context id of the run (a ULID, also used as the trace id). | `01KAV3RQ5Y2G3H4J5K6M7N8P9Q` |
| `homeassistant.context.parent_id` | string | Context id of the event or run that caused this run. | `01KAV3RQ5Y2G3H4J5K6M7N8P9R` |
| `homeassistant.domain` | string | Domain of the item that ran. | `automation`, `script` |
| `homeassistant.item_id` | string | Id of the automation or script inside its domain. | `1712345678901`, `piscina_ligar` |
| `homeassistant.last_step` | string | Path of the last step the run reached. | `action/2` |
| `homeassistant.run_id` | string | Id of the run in the trace store. | `6a1f0c2e9b8d4f7a` |
| `homeassistant.script_execution` | string | How the run ended. | `finished`, `failed_conditions`, `error`, `cancelled` |
| `homeassistant.step.child` | string | Run started by the step, as domain.item_id/run_id. | `script.rega/6a1f0c2e9b8d4f7a` |
| `homeassistant.step.path` | string | Path of the step in the automation or script config. | `action/1/if/condition/0` |
| `homeassistant.step.result` | template[string] | Scalar values of the step result, one attribute per key (a condition's `result`, an action's `running_script`...). Values keep their type (boolean, double or string); nested values such as service parameters are not recorded. | `true` |
| `homeassistant.step.variables` | template[string] | Scalar variables the step changed, one attribute per variable. Nested values (the trigger object, service data) are not recorded. | `on` |
| `homeassistant.trigger` | string | Description of what triggered the run. | `time pattern` |

| Attribute | Type | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `homeassistant.area.name` | string | Area of the entity, or of its device. | `Sala` |
| `homeassistant.device.manufacturer` | string | Device manufacturer. | `Aqara` |
| `homeassistant.device.model` | string | Device model. | `T1` |
| `homeassistant.device.name` | string | Name of the device the entity belongs to. | `Termometro sala` |
| `homeassistant.entity.device_class` | string | Device class of the entity. | `temperature`, `power` |
| `homeassistant.entity.domain` | string | Entity domain. | `sensor`, `switch` |
| `homeassistant.entity.id` | string | Entity id. | `sensor.sala_temperature` |
| `homeassistant.entity.name` | string | Friendly name of the entity. | `Sala temperature` |
| `homeassistant.entity.platform` | string | Integration that provides the entity. | `zha`, `shelly` |
| `homeassistant.entity.state` | string | Text state of the entity, on homeassistant.entity.state. | `heat`, `home`, `playing` |
| `homeassistant.floor.name` | string | Floor of the area. | `Rés-do-chão` |

### Home Assistant event attributes

Bus events sent as log records.

| Attribute | Type | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `homeassistant.event.data` | template[string] | Event data, one attribute per key; nested values are JSON. | `{"entity_id":"switch.bomba"}` |
| `homeassistant.event.origin` | string | Where the event was fired. | `LOCAL`, `REMOTE` |
| `homeassistant.event.type` | string | Event type. | `call_service`, `automation_triggered` |

### Journal attributes

Fields of the HAOS system journal (systemd-journald) kept on each log record.

| Attribute | Type | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `journald.boot_id` | string | Boot the entry belongs to (`_BOOT_ID`). | `3e1c0f6b2a9d4e8f9b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c` |
| `syslog.identifier` | string | Syslog identifier of the entry (`SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER`). | `kernel`, `dockerd` |
| `systemd.unit` | string | systemd unit that wrote the entry (`_SYSTEMD_UNIT`). | `docker.service`, `NetworkManager.service` |

### Python logging attributes

Parsed from Python logging lines (`logs_parse`).

| Attribute | Type | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `python.logger.name` | string | Name of the Python logger that wrote the line. | `homeassistant.components.mqtt`, `supervisor.addons.addon` |

## Metrics

### `homeassistant.core.up`

1 when Home Assistant Core answered the WebSocket API at this scrape, else 0. Instrument: gauge, unit `1`.

### `homeassistant.entity.available`

0 when the entity is unavailable, else 1. Instrument: gauge, unit `1`.

Entity values use the same attributes: `homeassistant.sensor.<device_class>` (numeric sensors, unit from the entity), `homeassistant.<domain>.value` (other numeric entities) and `homeassistant.<domain>.on` (1/0 for on/off entities).

Attributes: `homeassistant.area.name`, `homeassistant.device.manufacturer`, `homeassistant.device.model`, `homeassistant.device.name`, `homeassistant.entity.device_class`, `homeassistant.entity.domain`, `homeassistant.entity.id`, `homeassistant.entity.name`, `homeassistant.entity.platform`, `homeassistant.floor.name`.

### `homeassistant.entity.last_updated`

Unix time of the entity's last state update. Instrument: gauge, unit `s`.

Attributes: `homeassistant.entity.domain`, `homeassistant.entity.id`.

### `homeassistant.entity.state`

1 for the entity's current text state (one series per state value). Instrument: gauge, unit `1`.

Numeric states use homeassistant.sensor.<device_class> or homeassistant.<domain>.value instead; numeric state attributes are homeassistant.<domain>.attribute.<name>.

Attributes: `homeassistant.entity.id`, `homeassistant.entity.state`.

## Spans

### An automation or script run (root span).

Named `automation <alias>` or `script <alias>`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `homeassistant.alias` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.context.id` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.context.parent_id` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.domain` | required |
| `homeassistant.item_id` | required |
| `homeassistant.last_step` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.run_id` | required |
| `homeassistant.script_execution` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.trigger` | recommended |
| `user.id` | conditionally_required |

### One step of a run (trigger, condition, action...).

Named `<kind> <index>: <alias or type>`, e.g. `action 2: Ligar resistência`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `error.type` | conditionally_required |
| `homeassistant.step.child` | conditionally_required |
| `homeassistant.step.path` | required |
| `homeassistant.step.result` | recommended |
| `homeassistant.step.variables` | recommended |

## Events

### `homeassistant.automation_triggered`

An automation was triggered. Every Home Assistant event type is sent as `homeassistant.<event_type>`; the trace id comes from the event's context id.

Attributes: `homeassistant.context.id`, `homeassistant.context.parent_id`, `homeassistant.event.data`, `homeassistant.event.origin`, `homeassistant.event.type`, `user.id`.

### `homeassistant.call_service`

A service (action) was called. Every Home Assistant event type is sent as `homeassistant.<event_type>`; the trace id comes from the event's context id.

Attributes: `homeassistant.context.id`, `homeassistant.context.parent_id`, `homeassistant.event.data`, `homeassistant.event.origin`, `homeassistant.event.type`, `user.id`.

### `homeassistant.homeassistant_start`

Home Assistant is starting. Every Home Assistant event type is sent as `homeassistant.<event_type>`; the trace id comes from the event's context id.

Attributes: `homeassistant.context.id`, `homeassistant.context.parent_id`, `homeassistant.event.data`, `homeassistant.event.origin`, `homeassistant.event.type`, `user.id`.

### `homeassistant.homeassistant_stop`

Home Assistant is stopping. Every Home Assistant event type is sent as `homeassistant.<event_type>`; the trace id comes from the event's context id.

Attributes: `homeassistant.context.id`, `homeassistant.context.parent_id`, `homeassistant.event.data`, `homeassistant.event.origin`, `homeassistant.event.type`, `user.id`.

### `homeassistant.script_started`

A script started. Every Home Assistant event type is sent as `homeassistant.<event_type>`; the trace id comes from the event's context id.

Attributes: `homeassistant.context.id`, `homeassistant.context.parent_id`, `homeassistant.event.data`, `homeassistant.event.origin`, `homeassistant.event.type`, `user.id`.

### `journald.entry`

A HAOS journal entry (host service, kernel, Supervisor, Core or add-on container).

Attributes: `container.name`, `journald.boot_id`, `python.logger.name`, `syslog.identifier`, `systemd.unit`, `thread.name`.
